scope: Selected source contracts and supplied proof terms, not a kernel or declaration-closure audit.

literature_wrapper_inventory.scope: Lexical interface inventory from one pinned assembly file; names are not theorem-hypothesis verification.

checkpoint_status: Pinned endpoint theorem applications, coherent package fields, exact prime-sum/window quantifiers, and literature wrapper inventory; deeper constructors tracked separately.

endpoint_reduction.definition: For every positive modulus N, character chi and complex s with Re(s)>1/2 and (chi != 1 or s != 1), L(chi,s) != 0.
sufficient_inputs: Nonempty (Hyps (fun C => Closed C (fun Fm _ => LinkN Fm)) DRS)

duplicate_input_elimination.scope: Source bundle simplification, not elimination of its mathematical hypotheses.
duplicate_input_elimination.fact: OpenLiteratureStatements has fields Row, RecTExists, Row; MainConclusion supplies the same Row0b proof to both Row fields and vwin_of_row.

green_contract.meaning: Finite general linear cuspidal-character parametrization by regular irreducible polynomial labels, with degree, injectivity and exhaustion. Not a geometric Green-function estimate.

scalar_window_contract.order: There exist eD,eL,epsilon1>0 before forall 0<eps<epsilon1; each accuracy admits its own family and thresholds, with arbitrarily large multiplicative windows.
